payload.core_composition_summary: Prefix sum scan with modulo-divided cumulative handling and min tracking per residue class to efficiently evaluate all subarrays under the ceil cost model.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single algorithmic idea: prefix sums adjusted by K/M, with a fixed-size state array for modulo residues to account for the ceil term. No combination of distinct algorithm families like DP or greedy exchange.
